doc: Where a copied binding and a real file disagree (etalii.adp spec 009, FR-021). Each entry is checked by the real-file tests: an unlisted disagreement fails, and so does a listed one that has changed or no longer occurs. Never edit a copied binding, skip a file or weaken an assertion instead. A file is named by its path under fixtures/fbl/real-files, which is its path in etalii.adp.ide.standalone, so this record and standalone's can be compared line by line; it starts from standalone's entries at 25fc7b4a that are not cross-checks with its own parsers.

divergences.observed: 10 layout entries name no element: variable:Test, variable:attrition, variable:automation, variable:fatigue, variable:incidents, …
divergences.reason: The causal loop module stores positions under its wire ids ('variable:<name>'), while causal-loop-diagram.fbl reads a variable's id as its bare name, so these positions name no element of the reading and would be pruned as stale at the next write of the registration. Candidate follow-up for etalii.adp: give the binding's variables the module's 'variable:' prefix through the DISL id strategy, or migrate the registrations.

divergences.observed: no resource 'bronze_to_gold' among []
divergences.reason: This registration points the databricks/pipeline reading at the bundle file databricks.yml and selects the pipeline with 'resource: bronze_to_gold', but databricks-pipeline.fbl reads a pipeline settings document from its root and declares no registration.resource capture, so it finds no pipeline in the bundle. Candidate follow-up for etalii.adp: a resource capture over resources.pipelines.{pipeline} in databricks-pipeline.fbl.

divergences.observed: offset 200: The braces of the body do not balance on this line.
divergences.reason: FBL section 4.7 opens a block only when a statement's last non-whitespace character is '{', so 'model { // trailing a brace is legal' opens none and the matching '}' leaves the braces unbalanced, which makes the body unreadable. Structurizr accepts a comment after the brace, and the module reads this fixture. Candidate follow-up for etalii.adp: let FBL section 4.7 ignore a trailing comment matching the binding's comment expression before looking for '{'.
